content: When your own heart enters into stillness, the entire universe becomes still.
author: Japanese Proverbs
sourceWork: Zenrin Kushu (禅林句集) — Classical Zen Anthologies
explanation: We constantly blame noisy traffic, turbulent colleagues, and chaotic politics for our internal agitation. But the mirror only reflects what stands before it. When the agitated waters of your own mind settle into quiet awareness, the world ceases to be an enemy and becomes a quiet sanctuary.
practicalInsight: Before trying to fix a tense situation or argue with someone today, sit quietly for two minutes until your own pulse slows to a peaceful rhythm.
reflectionPrompt: Are you waiting for the world to calm down before you find peace, or are you willing to generate peace from within right now?
